cues.zh: 我想把他杀掉，因为我的心碎了。
cues.en: I wanted to kill him, because my heart was broken.
cues.note: 黑场起声，显出冷窗前的背影；念完留在窗前

cues.zh: 我们之间什么都不是。
cues.en: There was nothing between us.

cues.zh: 所以后来我也无法说，那是爱。
cues.en: So afterward, I could not call it love.
cues.note: 切同一扇窗的近景，玻璃里仍只有她

cues.zh: 但心碎不需要资格。
cues.en: But you do not need permission to have your heart broken.

cues.zh: 心碎是我唯一确定拥有过的东西。
cues.en: Heartbreak was the only thing I knew for certain I had ever had.
cues.note: 切窗台上的手，指尖松开

cues.zh: 不知道从什么时候开始，我学会了一个人做两人份的事。
cues.en: I cannot remember when I began doing things for two, alone.

cues.zh: 买菜买到刚好免配送费的额度，做饭做到刚好剩下一半。
cues.en: Buying just enough groceries for free delivery. Cooking just enough to leave half behind.

cues.zh: 把一半倒进垃圾桶的时候，会有一瞬间的犹豫。
cues.en: When I tipped that half into the bin, I would hesitate for an instant.

cues.zh: 好像明天他可能还会像以前那样，顺路过来一起吃。
cues.en: As if tomorrow he might still drop by for dinner, the way he used to.

cues.zh: 那种好，我反复咀嚼了很久。
cues.en: I chewed over that kindness for a long time.

cues.zh: 他对谁都是那样，我知道。
cues.en: He was like that with everyone. I knew.

cues.zh: 但我不肯吞下去。
cues.en: But I refused to swallow it.

cues.zh: 那天，他的父母来接他。
cues.en: That day, his parents came to pick him up.

cues.zh: 他们一家三口站在一起，说着什么，笑得很轻松。
cues.en: The three of them stood together, talking about something, laughing with ease.

cues.zh: 我拖着行李箱，一个人朝大巴的方向走。
cues.en: I dragged my suitcase toward the coach, alone.

cues.zh: 走得很慢。
cues.en: Very slowly.

cues.zh: 我在等他叫住我。
cues.en: I was waiting for him to call me back.

cues.zh: 等他跑过来，把我介绍给他的父母。
cues.en: To run over and introduce me to his parents.

cues.zh: 我当然知道这不会发生。
cues.en: Of course I knew it would not happen.

cues.zh: 但身体有自己的主意，它就是要走那么慢。
cues.en: But the body has a mind of its own. It insisted on walking that slowly.

cues.zh: 等我上了大巴，靠窗坐下，往外看的时候，他们早就走了。
cues.en: By the time I had boarded the coach, taken a window seat and looked outside, they were long gone.

cues.zh: 最后那段时间，我给他发了很多消息。
cues.en: Toward the end, I sent him a lot of messages.

cues.zh: 他一条都没有回。
cues.en: He did not reply to a single one.

cues.zh: 后来我把想说的话打进备忘录。
cues.en: Later, I typed what I wanted to say into my notes.

cues.zh: 长长短短，攒了好几千字。
cues.en: Long entries and short ones, several thousand words in all.

cues.zh: 手机在口袋里一震，我就想拿出来看。
cues.en: My phone buzzed in my pocket, and I wanted to take it out right away.

cues.zh: 我还是等走出店门，才把手机拿出来。
cues.en: I still waited until I had left the shop before taking out my phone.
cues.note: 这条只在便利店画面显示；其后空白手机特写停留 2.5 秒

cues.zh: 什么都没有。
cues.en: Nothing.
cues.note: 出便利店后的锁屏上滑与回弹结束，再显示；使用原有停留段，不顺延舞会。

cues.zh: 那个梦是后来才来的。
cues.en: The dream came later.

cues.zh: 毕业舞会上，人群散去，灯亮了。
cues.en: At the graduation ball, the crowd had drifted away and the lights had come on.

cues.zh: 他穿着黑色西装，眉眼含笑地朝我走过来。
cues.en: He walked toward me in a black suit, a smile in his eyes.

cues.zh: 我们坐在一起，调侃着对方。
cues.en: We sat together, teasing each other.

cues.zh: 随后他的手抚上我的脖子，轻轻吻了我。
cues.en: Then his hand touched my neck, and he kissed me softly.

cues.zh: 那个吻，成了我们之间唯一的告别。
cues.en: That kiss became the only goodbye we ever had.

cues.zh: 再往后，我在超市、地铁、电影院里看到过和他相似的背影。
cues.en: After that, I saw people who looked like him from behind, in supermarkets, on the metro, at the cinema.
cues.note: 随「超市」「地铁」「电影院」依次切背影

cues.zh: 有一回，那个人侧过身，让后面的人先过去。
cues.en: Once, someone turned sideways to let another person pass.

cues.zh: 我看清了那个人的脸，知道认错了。
cues.en: I saw his face and knew I had mistaken him for someone else.
cues.note: 保留用户确认分句：先认错

cues.zh: 却还是等他转过身，又看了一眼他的背影。
cues.en: But I still waited for him to turn away and looked at his back once more.
cues.note: 保留用户确认分句：再转回背影

cues.zh: 很快，第二个他出现了。
cues.en: Soon, a second him appeared.

cues.zh: 那时我们还没每周一起吃饭。
cues.en: Back then, we had not yet started eating together every week.
cues.note: 留在教室，两人各自收拾桌面；读完半秒后切车窗
